transforms.operation: Normalize the friendly force-disposition display name to its repository id.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
/disposition.reason: The verified friendly disposition relation and existing disposition slugger establish the value, but no current MFM pass authors mission-matchup records.

/game_version.reason: The matchup release/version label is repository-authored; dump snapshot metadata is not an entity game-version source.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: The dataslate label is repository-authored and is not inferred from dump snapshot metadata.

/game_version/edition.reason: The edition label is repository-authored and is not inferred from dump snapshot metadata.

transforms.operation: Normalize each ordered disposition display name and join the friendly and opposition slugs with '-vs-'.

filters: Use English localized display names for both sides.
precedence: Preserve the ordered friendly-versus-opposition slug pair; do not replace it with the dump row id.
/id.reason: The deterministic repository key is derivable from the two verified disposition relations, while current mission ingestion does not author matchup records.

transforms.operation: Normalize the linked primary-mission English display name to the repository mission id.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
Retain only primary missions represented by the repository mission inventory.
/mission_id.reason: The verified primary-mission relation identifies the mission; existing mission reconciliation consumes that primary-mission identity but does not yet write mission-matchup records.

transforms.operation: Normalize the opposition force-disposition display name to its repository id.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
/opponent_disposition.reason: The verified opposition disposition relation and existing disposition slugger establish the value, but no current MFM pass authors mission-matchup records.
